about: The 15 OpenCode Go models, one run each. The judge saw run codes (M123), not model names.
scale: 1 to 5: support for every claim, coverage of the items, no invented references

scores.label: M123-lit_note

scores.label: M123-synthesis
scores.why: All 15 tagged items, 10 full texts read, verified quotes with pages; several claims in Disagreements/Gaps lack a citekey and one quote ('legal accountability is still a grey area') is attributed to jenko2025 though it appears in the costa2026 text.

scores.label: M123-search
scores.why: 5 traced DOIs, overlap stated (1 in library), but 2 of 5 picks (general AI-governance SLR, generative-AI governance) are not EU-specific; very brief.

scores.label: M123-lit
scores.why: 15 sources with evidence table and read levels, but FRA cited with invented citekey europeanagencyforfundamentalrights2025, verification BLOCKED, plan task list never updated, some unsourced claims ('policymakers maintain...').
